subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1
solution:
The correct answer is "It". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, the most appropriate answer for the blank no. 1 is 'It'
 
• It is a pronoun.
 
• A pronoun is a word that takes place of a noun.
 
 
• Example: *I am scared of the dog, it is always growling at me*
 
 
 
• In the above example, it has been used to replace the reference to the dog.
